title: Why the Banking Crisis Isn’t Over Yet

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片打碟的那个年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，展示着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: There's growing concern that the bank crisis could spread.
sentences.zh: 人们越来越担心银行危机可能会蔓延。

sentences.en: Today, shares of San Francisco-based First Republic Bank lost more than half their value on Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 今天，总部位于旧金山的第一共和银行在华尔街的股价缩水了一半以上。

sentences.en: Today, as the banking crisis enters its second week.
sentences.zh: 今天，银行业危机进入了第二周。

sentences.en: Yeah, worst week since 2020 last week, John, and this week is not starting out on a better note.
sentences.zh: 没错，约翰，上周是自2020年以来最糟糕的一周，而本周的开局也不容乐观。

sentences.en: We look at the spreading fallout.
sentences.zh: 我们来看看正在蔓延的余波。

sentences.en: And it's elsewhere in the regional banks as well.
sentences.zh: 其他区域性银行也出现了同样的情况。

sentences.en: PacWest, Western Alliance, Zions, they're all down substantially in the first few minutes of trading here.
sentences.zh: 太平洋西部银行、西部联盟银行、锡安银行，在开盘后的最初几分钟里，它们的股价都大幅下跌。

sentences.en: And why the government's attempt to contain it is meeting so much resistance from bank investors and customers.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么政府试图遏制危机的努力，遭到了银行投资者和客户的强烈抵制。

sentences.en: We turn once again to my colleague, Emily Flitter.
sentences.zh: 我们再次连线我的同事艾米丽·弗利特。

sentences.en: Emily, it has now been nearly a week since this banking crisis began.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，这场银行业危机爆发至今已经快一周了。

sentences.en: And if we roll back the clock to more or less this very moment a week ago, last Thursday, customers of Silicon Valley Bank were frantically withdrawing $42 billion from that bank.
sentences.zh: 如果我们把时间拨回到一周前的大约这个时候，也就是上周四，硅谷银行的客户正在疯狂地从该行提取420亿美元。

sentences.en: It was becoming a huge crisis, which is why the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那场危机愈演愈烈，这就是为什么美国

sentences.en: government stepped in and took over that bank and began crafting a rescue operation that involved taking over yet another bank, Signature Bank.
sentences.zh: 政府介入并接管了该银行，并开始制定一项救援计划，其中还包括接管另一家银行——签名银行。

sentences.en: And that's where things were when we talked to you earlier this week.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们本周早些时候和你交谈时的情况。

sentences.en: And where that episode left off was with President Biden telling Americans, your money is safe.
sentences.zh: 而上一期节目的结尾是拜登总统告诉美国人民：你们的钱是安全的。

sentences.en: It's going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: So pick up the story from there.
sentences.zh: 那么，请从那里接着讲起。

sentences.en: So when we last spoke, it was Monday afternoon, there was still this sense that everybody was
sentences.zh: 所以当我们上次通话时，那是周一下午，大家仍然感觉

sentences.en: holding their breath, trying to figure out exactly how the federal government's actions were landing.
sentences.zh: 屏住呼吸，试图弄清楚联邦政府的行动到底产生了什么影响。

sentences.en: And there were a lot of questions like, how would bank investors react as the week wore on?
sentences.zh: 当时有很多疑问，比如随着本周的推移，银行投资者会作何反应？

sentences.en: And how would bank customers react?
sentences.zh: 银行客户又会作何反应？

sentences.en: Would people still be itching to get their money to a different spot?
sentences.zh: 人们是否仍然急于把钱转到别的地方？

sentences.en: What we saw was that everybody was jittery.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是，每个人都忧心忡忡。

sentences.en: And one of the places where the continued lack of confidence was most evident was in the regional banks.
sentences.zh: 而持续缺乏信心表现得最明显的地方之一就是区域性银行。

sentences.en: First Republic, Western Alliance, PacWeSt.
sentences.zh: 第一共和银行、西部联盟银行、太平洋西部银行。

sentences.en: These banks were still seeing customers pull their money out, and they were seeing their stock value plummet too.
sentences.zh: 这些银行的客户仍在不断提款，它们的股价也在暴跌。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And what's your sense, Emily, of why these regional banks and their stock, why they're plunging when this federal plan that had been announced over the weekend,
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，你认为为什么这些区域性银行及其股票会暴跌，尽管联邦政府在周末宣布了一项计划，

sentences.en: which we talked to you about in this episode, was designed to reassure everyone that things were fine, that everyone's money was safe, that they shouldn't be in a panic anymore?
sentences.zh: 也就是我们在那期节目中和你讨论过的，旨在让大家放心，一切都很好，每个人的钱都是安全的，他们不应该再恐慌了？

sentences.en: The short answer is interest rates.
sentences.zh: 简短的回答是：利率。

sentences.en: Investors looked at these banks, they looked at how surprising Silicon Valley Bank was in its failures to manage interest rate risk,
sentences.zh: 投资者审视这些银行，看到硅谷银行在管理利率风险方面的失败是多么令人震惊，

sentences.en: and they thought, why should we assume that these other banks have done a better job than Silicon Valley Bank did?
sentences.zh: 他们想，我们凭什么认为这些银行比硅谷银行做得更好呢？

sentences.en: And just as a reminder of what you told us last time, Silicon Valley Bank had invested in things that looked really great
sentences.zh: 提醒一下你上次告诉我们的，硅谷银行投资了一些看起来非常棒的东西，

sentences.en: when interest rates were low and looked a lot less great when interest rates had risen over the past year and then decided they didn't need to sell those investments off,
sentences.zh: 在利率较低时看起来很棒，但在过去一年利率上升后看起来就没那么好了，然后他们决定不需要卖掉这些投资，

sentences.en: which is what scared the bejesus out of investors because they lost money on that sale.
sentences.zh: 这把投资者吓坏了，因为他们在抛售中亏了钱。

sentences.en: That's right, and it was malpractice to a certain extent by Silicon Valley Bank that they didn't take into account
sentences.zh: 没错，硅谷银行在某种程度上存在失职，他们没有考虑到

sentences.en: that the Fed had this plan that they were executing that they had been really clear about to raise interest rates to counteract inflation.
sentences.zh: 美联储正在执行一项非常明确的计划，即通过提高利率来对抗通胀。

sentences.en: And so basically, the Biden administration came out and wanted to tell everybody, look, it's fine, we've got this.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，拜登政府出来想告诉大家：看，没关系，我们能搞定。

sentences.en: And it was almost like when a little kid falls over and they look to the adults to see how the adults are reacting,
sentences.zh: 这就像一个小孩子摔倒了，他们会看着大人，看大人的反应，

sentences.en: whether they're going, oh, no, oh, no, or whether they're just like, oh, you fell, it's okay, you know, to decide whether to cry.
sentences.zh: 看大人是惊慌失措地喊“噢不，噢不”，还是平静地说“噢，你摔倒了，没关系”，以此来决定自己要不要哭。

sentences.en: The Biden administration wanted to say, it's fine, this was a little stumble.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府想说：没关系，这只是一个小挫折。

sentences.en: The markets just weren't accepting that.
sentences.zh: 但市场并不买账。

sentences.en: I mean, there was a wail that was coming out whether or not the adults in the room wanted it to.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，无论房间里的大人们是否愿意，哀嚎声还是传了出来。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And in this fascinating metaphor, the Biden administration is the parent who fails to calm their kid
sentences.zh: 在这个引人入胜的隐喻中，拜登政府就像那个没能安抚好孩子，

sentences.en: and instead makes their kid freak out, in fact, makes every kid on the block freak out
sentences.zh: 反而让孩子惊慌失措的家长，事实上，让街区里的每个孩子都惊慌失措，

sentences.en: by being so urgent in their response to the scraped knee that was Silicon Valley Bank's bad decision-making around interest rates.
sentences.zh: 因为他们对硅谷银行在利率决策上的失误所导致的“擦伤”反应过于强烈。

sentences.en: These banks, we were told, did not pose systemic risk.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知，这些银行不会构成系统性风险。

sentences.en: We were told that within the past five or six years when regulators and Congress got together and actually loosened regulations on these banks.
sentences.zh: 我们在过去五六年里被告知过，当时监管机构和国会聚在一起，实际上放宽了对这些银行的监管。

sentences.en: So if they weren't that big a deal and one of them could fail and it wouldn't bring down the system,
sentences.zh: 所以如果它们没那么重要，其中一家倒闭也不会拖垮整个系统，

sentences.en: why did the administration come out and say that Silicon Valley Bank's depositors all needed to be made whole because it was a systemic risk if they were not?
sentences.zh: 为什么政府出来说硅谷银行的所有存款人都需要得到全额赔付，因为这构成了系统性风险？

sentences.en: I think that was a pretty big step and this was the way that markets reacted when they opened.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个相当大的举措，这就是市场开盘时的反应。

sentences.en: But is this underlying fear that the rising interest rate is a problem for all these regional banks that are seeing their stock price go down?
sentences.zh: 但这种潜在的恐惧是否在于，利率上升对所有这些股价下跌的区域性银行来说都是一个问题？

sentences.en: Is that actually a reflection of bad decisions made by these banks around the interest rate and real vulnerability?
sentences.zh: 这实际上反映了这些银行在利率决策上的失误和真正的脆弱性吗？

sentences.en: Or is this just sort of irrational and fear making more fear?
sentences.zh: 还是说这只是一种非理性的恐惧，让恐惧滋生了更多的恐惧？

sentences.en: Well, the question that investors had to answer on Monday morning when the markets opened was were they willing to bet their own money or, you know, their clients' money
sentences.zh: 嗯，投资者在周一开盘时必须回答的问题是：他们是否愿意拿自己的钱，或者客户的钱去赌，

sentences.en: that there weren't going to be any more problems among these regional banks caused by rising interest rates?
sentences.zh: 赌这些区域性银行不会因为利率上升而出现更多问题？

sentences.en: And they decided it's not a safe bet.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这不是一个稳妥的赌注。

sentences.en: We're worried and we're going to express that worry.
sentences.zh: 我们很担心，我们要表达这种担忧。

sentences.en: And then on Tuesday, they got a little confirmation of this worry in the form of ratings agencies coming out and saying,
sentences.zh: 然后在周二，他们得到了一点这种担忧的证实，评级机构出来说：

sentences.en: we too are re-evaluating the security and stability of these regional banks based on their management of interest rate risk.
sentences.zh: 我们也正在根据这些区域性银行对利率风险的管理，重新评估它们的安全性与稳定性。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Which is exactly the kind of signal that would make investors worried because they're suddenly getting a rating agency,
sentences.zh: 这正是那种会让投资者担心的信号，因为他们突然得到了一家评级机构的评价，

sentences.en: which is the kind of institution we all trust to tell us what's what, saying we too are kind of worried about whether rising interest rates are bad for these banks.
sentences.zh: 评级机构是我们大家都信任的、能告诉我们真相的机构，它们说：我们也担心利率上升对这些银行是否不利。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And let me just take a moment, though, to make a very important note about these rating agencies.
sentences.zh: 不过，请允许我花点时间，对这些评级机构做一个非常重要的说明。

sentences.en: It's up to investors, especially in this situation, to decide whether the ratings agencies are identifying a real problem or just trying to cover their keisters.
sentences.zh: 投资者，尤其是在这种情况下，需要自行判断评级机构是在发现真正的问题，还是仅仅在推卸责任。

sentences.en: These ratings agencies are supposed to be watching all of the entities that they're providing ratings for really closely.
sentences.zh: 这些评级机构本应密切关注它们提供评级的所有实体。

sentences.en: And so even the ratings agencies saying we're re-evaluating, if you're a market participant, you've got to figure out like how much weight to give that.
sentences.zh: 所以即使是评级机构说我们正在重新评估，如果你是一个市场参与者，你必须弄清楚该给这个评价多大的权重。

sentences.en: So just to be very clear, even though we know because this is what you told us that Silicon Valley Bank failed not because interest rates went up,
sentences.zh: 所以要非常明确的是，尽管我们知道——因为这是你告诉我们的——硅谷银行倒闭不是因为利率上升，

sentences.en: but because they didn't plan for those interest rates going up in a prudent way.
sentences.zh: 而是因为他们没有以审慎的方式为利率上升做好计划。

sentences.en: And what happened to them, therefore, was fundamentally unique.
sentences.zh: 因此，发生在他们身上的事情从根本上说是独特的。

sentences.en: All these investors, they don't want to take that bet that Silicon Valley Bank's situation was unique.
sentences.zh: 所有的投资者，他们不想去赌硅谷银行的情况是独特的。

sentences.en: And now the ratings agency is giving them a reason to lean into their doubts and to sell the stocks of your first republics and your Western alliances and so on.
sentences.zh: 现在评级机构给了他们一个理由去加深怀疑，去抛售第一共和银行、西部联盟银行等等的股票。

sentences.en: This is all leading to a lot of investors getting pretty spooked.
sentences.zh: 这一切导致许多投资者变得相当惊慌。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Even though there's not really any evidence that they should be spooked.
sentences.zh: 尽管并没有什么证据表明他们应该感到惊慌。

sentences.en: Not only is there not definitive evidence that they should be spooked, but the Fed and the Biden administration are out there saying, essentially, it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 不仅没有确凿的证据表明他们应该惊慌，而且美联储和拜登政府也在外面说，本质上，这没关系。

sentences.en: Whatever these banks are doing with their interest rate risk management, we're going to work it out and we're going to make sure
sentences.zh: 无论这些银行在利率风险管理方面做什么，我们都会解决它，我们会确保

sentences.en: that they all can access enough cash at the drop of a hat that they should be able to get through this.
sentences.zh: 它们都能在需要时获得足够的现金，这样它们就应该能够度过难关。

sentences.en: That's the message that the financial regulators and the White House want people to come away with.
sentences.zh: 这就是金融监管机构和白宫希望人们得出的结论。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So this is a whole lot of fallout for not a very good reason, which if you've covered the financial markets, you kind of know is the very nature of investing.
sentences.zh: 所以这完全是无谓的余波，如果你报道过金融市场，你就会知道这就是投资的本质。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, there's been kind of an outsized fallout from Silicon Valley Bank failing for what is essentially bad management
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，硅谷银行的倒闭产生了一种过度的余波，而这本质上是管理不善，

sentences.en: and specifically the decision to sell off an entire portfolio of securities at an almost $2 billion loss and publicize that sale.
sentences.zh: 特别是决定以近20亿美元的亏损抛售整个证券投资组合，并公开了这一销售行为。

sentences.en: And what we recently learned is that the people who advised them to do that and to publicize the fact that they had done it
sentences.zh: 我们最近了解到，那些建议他们这样做，并建议他们公开这一事实的人，

sentences.en: are getting paid or are charging at least $100 million for that advice.
sentences.zh: 正在为此收取至少1亿美元的咨询费。

sentences.en: That's Goldman Sachs.
sentences.zh: 那就是高盛。

sentences.en: Which seems to put an even finer point on the idea that what happened at Silicon Valley Bank was unique based on what seems like uniquely bad advice and decisions.
sentences.zh: 这似乎更明确地表明，硅谷银行发生的事情是独特的，是基于看起来极其糟糕的建议和决策。

sentences.en: And therefore, this is not really a risk to the whole system.
sentences.zh: 因此，这实际上对整个系统并不构成风险。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If you're an investor, you have to take all these different inputs.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一名投资者，你必须吸收所有这些不同的信息。

sentences.en: The government's reaction, which is meant to reassure, but maybe actually is a signal of how bad things are or almost were.
sentences.zh: 政府的反应旨在安抚人心，但可能实际上是一个信号，表明情况有多糟糕，或者差点有多糟糕。

sentences.en: Everybody's in the marketplace trying to synthesize all of this stuff.
sentences.zh: 市场上的每个人都在试图综合所有这些信息。

sentences.en: And what they decide to do is to pull back, to say, I'm just not willing to bet my money on everything being totally fine.
sentences.zh: 他们决定采取的做法是退缩，说：我不想拿我的钱去赌一切都会完全好起来。

sentences.en: And that has real-world effects in the market.
sentences.zh: 这在市场上产生了现实的影响。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And it feels like one of the major real-world effects in the market is a development that is entirely unexpected by me at least that happens this week.
sentences.zh: 感觉市场上一个主要的现实影响是本周发生的一件我完全没预料到的事情。

sentences.en: And it happens not in the U.S., but over in Europe.
sentences.zh: 而且它不是发生在美国，而是在欧洲。

sentences.en: And that's what happens at Credit Suisse, this major bank based in Switzerland that suddenly seems like it's in crisis.
sentences.zh: 那就是瑞士信贷发生的事情，这家总部位于瑞士的大型银行突然看起来陷入了危机。

sentences.en: So what the heck was happening there?
sentences.zh: 那么那里到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: So let me walk you through it.
sentences.zh: 让我为你梳理一下。

sentences.en: Credit Suisse has not been okay since basically the financial crisis.
sentences.zh: 瑞士信贷基本上从金融危机以来就一直不太好。

sentences.en: They went through the crisis like everybody else, kind of came out a little shaky, but then they made a bunch of really bad decisions,
sentences.zh: 他们像其他人一样经历了危机，出来时有点摇摇欲坠，但随后他们做出了一系列非常糟糕的决定，

sentences.en: and they just never really got back on solid footing.
sentences.zh: 他们就再也没有真正站稳脚跟。

sentences.en: So that's the backdrop against which the American banking crisis starts to lead investors in Europe to look at Credit Suisse again.
sentences.zh: 这就是美国银行业危机开始导致欧洲投资者再次审视瑞士信贷的背景。

sentences.en: And when they do take that look, they see a couple of new things that, while they're kind of small, are problematic.
sentences.zh: 当他们真的去审视时，他们看到了一些新的东西，虽然它们有点小，但却是有问题的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Such as?
sentences.zh: 比如？

sentences.en: The first one is that the Swiss financial regulator came out and said, uh, we've found some material weaknesses in Credit Suisse's accounting practices.
sentences.zh: 第一点是瑞士金融监管机构出来说：呃，我们在瑞士信贷的会计实务中发现了一些重大缺陷。

sentences.en: Not the hugest deal in the world, but when you're talking about a global financial market in which an American bank has just shocked everyone by failing because of bad practices,
sentences.zh: 这并不是什么惊天动地的大事，但当你谈论的是一个全球金融市场，而一家美国银行刚刚因为糟糕的实务操作而震惊了所有人时，

sentences.en: you're going to look at that with some more seriousness.
sentences.zh: 你会更严肃地看待这个问题。

sentences.en: And then the other thing is, a big investor in Credit Suisse was being interviewed, and he just kind of casually said he wasn't going to increase his stake in the bank any further.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是，瑞士信贷的一位大投资者在接受采访时，随口说他不会再增加在该行的持股比例。

sentences.en: And people took that as a sign of a loss of confidence, when really it was just the investor talking about his own strategy.
sentences.zh: 人们把它解读为信心丧失的信号，而实际上这只是投资者在谈论他自己的策略。

sentences.en: That didn't have to do with his views on whether the bank was a good investment.
sentences.zh: 这与他是否认为该银行是一项好的投资无关。

sentences.en: So without sort of really understanding it, people who had investments in Credit Suisse basically said, oh my God, we need to rethink what we've been doing.
sentences.zh: 所以，在没有真正理解的情况下，那些在瑞士信贷有投资的人基本上说：天哪，我们需要重新考虑我们一直在做的事情。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So in a way, what's happening at Credit Suisse is just a measure of how hypersensitive and fearful everyone is of what's happening over in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上说，瑞士信贷发生的事情只是衡量大家对美国正在发生的事情有多么过敏和恐惧的一个指标。

sentences.en: Because in a lot of ways, what you're describing is not an analogous situation.
sentences.zh: 因为在很多方面，你所描述的情况并不具有可比性。

sentences.en: It's a pretty unique situation to Credit Suisse, just as it was a unique situation at Silicon Valley Bank.
sentences.zh: 这对瑞士信贷来说是一个相当独特的情况，就像硅谷银行的情况一样独特。

sentences.en: But people are making all kinds of scared linkages in their head.
sentences.zh: 但人们在脑海中建立了各种各样的恐惧联系。

sentences.en: I mean, nobody was going to tell you two weeks ago that Credit Suisse was the pillar of banking practices and stability and the best investment ever.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，两周前没人会告诉你瑞士信贷是银行业务和稳定性的支柱，是最好的投资。

sentences.en: But there's a different context now and there's a different tolerance for shenanigans.
sentences.zh: 但现在背景不同了，对混乱的容忍度也不同了。

sentences.en: And Credit Suisse has been trying to get its act together for so long that any little thing is just going to set people off and that's what happened.
sentences.zh: 瑞士信贷为了重回正轨已经努力了太久，任何一点小事都会引发人们的恐慌，这就是发生的事情。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So Emily, bring us up to where we are because all of this is still playing out in a very messy real-time way.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，带我们了解一下现状，因为这一切仍然以一种非常混乱的实时方式上演。

sentences.en: So where are we right now?
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在处于什么位置？

sentences.en: So it's Thursday and things are calming down for Credit Suisse.
sentences.zh: 现在是周四，瑞士信贷的情况正在平息。

sentences.en: Investors are finally embracing the measures that the Swiss government took to help stabilize the bank.
sentences.zh: 投资者终于接受了瑞士政府为帮助稳定该银行所采取的措施。

sentences.en: They, this week, provided $54 billion in loans to the bank.
sentences.zh: 他们本周向该银行提供了540亿美元的贷款。

sentences.en: And it's a move that we can say worked because global stocks have reacted positively.
sentences.zh: 我们可以说这一举措奏效了，因为全球股市做出了积极反应。

sentences.en: Another thing is that the European Central Bank raised interest rates today.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是欧洲央行今天提高了利率。

sentences.en: And that is really significant because there were people who were thinking that maybe this turmoil, which has been attributed so much
sentences.zh: 这非常重要，因为有些人认为这场动荡——很大程度上归因于美国利率上升——可能会导致一直协同行动的全球央行

sentences.en: to rising interest rates here in the United States, could basically cause the central banks around the world who have been acting in some coordination
sentences.zh: 暂停加息。

sentences.en: to pause on the interest rate hikes.
sentences.zh: 而欧洲央行今天发出信号，他们不会让这种情况阻止他们的议程。

sentences.en: And the European Central Bank signaled today that they're not going to let this stop their agenda.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 所以欧洲银行体系传达的信息是：在提高利率以抑制通胀方面，尽管空气中弥漫着各种担忧，

sentences.en: So the message from the European banking system is when it comes to increasing interest rates to tame inflation, it's full steam ahead, despite all these worries in the air
sentences.zh: 认为这导致了美国银行的金融混乱，但他们仍将全速前进。

sentences.en: that that has been contributing to the financial mess over in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: with our banks.
sentences.zh: 无论市场参与者多么想抱怨利率上升，这都是一个信号，表明到目前为止发生的一切还不够糟糕。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And however much market participants may want to complain about interest rates going up, it's a signal that says nothing that has happened so far is bad enough
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: that we need to go into crisis mode and change our strategy here.
sentences.zh: 我们需要进入危机模式，并在此处改变我们的策略。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And what about here in the United States?
sentences.zh: 那美国这边的情况如何呢？

sentences.en: What is happening today?
sentences.zh: 今天发生了什么？

sentences.en: So today turns out to be a big day for First Republic.
sentences.zh: 今天对第一共和银行来说是个大日子。

sentences.en: It has lost most of its stock value this week.
sentences.zh: 它本周损失了大部分股票价值。

sentences.en: It got downgraded by ratings agencies.
sentences.zh: 它被评级机构下调了评级。

sentences.en: And at the beginning of today, we thought the best thing that can happen to this bank is that somebody else buys them.
sentences.zh: 在今天刚开始的时候，我们认为对这家银行来说最好的事情就是被别人收购。

sentences.en: And then later on Thursday, the federal government and the biggest banks announced that they're putting $30 billion of deposits into First Republic.
sentences.zh: 后来在周四，联邦政府和几家大型银行宣布，他们将向第一共和银行存入300亿美元的存款。

sentences.en: These deposits are coming from the biggest banks,
sentences.zh: 这些存款来自几家大型银行，

sentences.en: Bank of America, J.P.
sentences.zh: 美国银行，摩根大通。

sentences.en: Morgan.
sentences.zh: 摩根。

sentences.en: And in a deal brokered by the Treasury Department and the Fed, they're going to send these deposits to First Republic in order to just express confidence in the bank,
sentences.zh: 在财政部和美联储斡旋的协议下，他们将把这些存款汇入第一共和银行，以表达对该银行的信心，

sentences.en: to stabilize the bank, and show its other customers that they don't have to go anywhere.
sentences.zh: 稳定该银行，并向其其他客户表明他们不必离开。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Which would be their way of kind of just getting out of this troubled moment.
sentences.zh: 这算是他们摆脱当前困境的一种方式。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: It's something that these big banks can do easily.
sentences.zh: 这对这些大银行来说很容易做到。

sentences.en: They're essentially sending their own deposits to First Republic and just promising not to yank them back right away.
sentences.zh: 他们本质上是将自己的存款存入第一共和银行，并承诺不会立即撤回。

sentences.en: And that way First Republic can weather this and it's a win-win because it helps stabilize the whole system and hopefully it'll also help calm the stock market down.
sentences.zh: 这样第一共和银行就能挺过难关，这是一个双赢的局面，因为它有助于稳定整个系统，希望也能有助于平息股市。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Speaking of, I also noticed today that while all this is happening, the stock price of the bigger banks in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 说到这个，我还注意到今天在这一切发生的同时，美国大型银行的股价，

sentences.en: like Bank of America, like J.P.
sentences.zh: 比如美国银行，比如摩根大通，

sentences.en: Morgan, have been extremely stable and in some cases have been going up a little bit.
sentences.zh: 一直非常稳定，在某些情况下甚至还有所上涨。

sentences.en: And that makes me wonder or maybe it makes me assume that customers of these regional banks who are spooked by what's happening there are taking their deposits
sentences.zh: 这让我怀疑，或者说让我推测，那些被区域性银行现状吓坏了的客户正在提取存款，

sentences.en: and putting them into these much bigger banks.
sentences.zh: 并把它们存入这些规模大得多的银行。

sentences.en: Is there evidence that that's been happening?
sentences.zh: 有证据表明这种情况正在发生吗？

sentences.en: Well, let's just decouple the share price movement a little bit from what depositors are doing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们先把股价走势和储户的行为稍微分开来看。

sentences.en: But I think that the story of the biggest banks looking very desirable right now is a story that those banks are absolutely delighted to tell people.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，大型银行目前看起来非常受欢迎，这是一个那些银行绝对乐于向人们讲述的故事。

sentences.en: Because this is kind of the first time since the financial crisis when being too big to fail is a good thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这算是自金融危机以来，第一次“大到不能倒”成了一件好事。

sentences.en: But I also want to mention something, and this isn't just optics.
sentences.zh: 但我还要提一点，这不仅仅是表面文章。

sentences.en: Bank of America, according to Bloomberg, who reported this citing anonymous sources,
sentences.zh: 据彭博社援引匿名消息来源报道，

sentences.en: attracted $15 billion in new deposits just this past week.
sentences.zh: 美国银行仅在上周就吸引了150亿美元的新存款。

sentences.en: That means that they essentially benefited from these bank runs.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们本质上从这些银行挤兑中获益了。

sentences.en: They have pledged $5 billion in deposits for First Republic.
sentences.zh: 他们已承诺为第一共和银行存入50亿美元的存款。

sentences.en: So think about it.
sentences.zh: 所以想一想。

sentences.en: That's pretty comfortable math for them.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说算盘打得很精。

sentences.en: Big banks have not always been the first choice for a lot of American businesses because they don't treat their small and mid-sized corporate customers
sentences.zh: 大银行并不总是许多美国企业的首选，因为他们对待中小型企业客户时，

sentences.en: with as much high-touch attention that the regional banks have been treating them with.
sentences.zh: 不像区域性银行那样提供高度个性化的关注。

sentences.en: So there was like a real tangible reason why you didn't want to be the customer of the biggest banks unless you were a huge company.
sentences.zh: 所以，除非你是大公司，否则你不想成为大银行的客户是有切实原因的。

sentences.en: Now, instead of the personal care that these companies were looking for, they just want stability.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些公司不再追求个性化服务，他们只想要稳定。

sentences.en: And they want to know that their money isn't going to go poof.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道自己的钱不会凭空消失。

sentences.en: And that's a really simplistic way to put it because there are plenty of ways if you're a mid-sized company to manage your cash so you don't get into the problems
sentences.zh: 这样说可能太简单了，因为如果你是一家中型公司，有很多方法可以管理现金，这样你就不会陷入

sentences.en: that the Silicon Valley Bank customers had or many of them.
sentences.zh: 硅谷银行客户所遇到的那些问题，或者说他们中的许多人所遇到的问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it makes sense that big banks would relish this storyline.
sentences.zh: 大银行会喜欢这个故事线也是合情合理的。

sentences.en: But I'm now wondering if we're witnessing, in a way, the kind of waning days of the regional bank.
sentences.zh: 但我现在想知道，我们是否在某种程度上见证了区域性银行走向衰落的日子。

sentences.en: Is everything we're talking about here essentially an existential threat to the very idea of our regional banking system?
sentences.zh: 我们在这里讨论的一切，本质上是否对我们的区域性银行体系构成了生存威胁？

sentences.en: That's a huge call to make.
sentences.zh: 这个结论下得太大了。

sentences.en: And I don't think we're quite there yet.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们还没到那个地步。

sentences.en: First of all, the government, especially the Biden administration, does not want to see smaller banks disappear.
sentences.zh: 首先，政府，特别是拜登政府，不希望看到小型银行消失。

sentences.en: I spoke with Maxine Waters of the House Financial Services Committee.
sentences.zh: 我与众议院金融服务委员会的玛克辛·沃特斯谈过。

sentences.en: She's a congresswoman from California.
sentences.zh: 她是来自加利福尼亚州的国会女议员。

sentences.en: She's a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 她是民主党人。

sentences.en: And I asked her, what do you think should happen going forward?
sentences.zh: 我问她，你认为未来应该发生什么？

sentences.en: And she said, I am not a fan of bank mergers.
sentences.zh: 她说，我不支持银行合并。

sentences.en: I don't want this country to be a country that basically relies on four or five huge banks.
sentences.zh: 我不希望这个国家变成一个基本上只依赖四五家巨型银行的国家。

sentences.en: And so I think you're going to see a lot of pushback to the idea that regional banks are going away and that the big banks are going to step in.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，你会看到很多反对意见，反对区域性银行将消失、大银行将取而代之的观点。

sentences.en: Well, what did she say she fears if we lose regional banks, if Bank of America or Wells Fargo buys up the regional banks?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果区域性银行消失，如果美国银行或富国银行收购了区域性银行，她担心会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, this is a position that many in Congress and in the Biden administration have held for a long time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是国会和拜登政府中许多人长期以来一直持有的立场。

sentences.en: They don't want to see the biggest banks become so dominant that they can start treating their customers really terribly because their customers don't have any other options.
sentences.zh: 他们不希望看到大银行变得如此占据主导地位，以至于它们开始极其恶劣地对待客户，因为客户别无选择。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the image we have of regional banks
sentences.zh: 我们对区域性银行的印象是，

sentences.en: is that they're on the ground level, right?
sentences.zh: 它们扎根于基层，对吧？

sentences.en: That they have a personal connection to their clients.
sentences.zh: 它们与客户有个人联系。

sentences.en: They have dinner, perhaps, with their clients.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至可能与客户共进晚餐。

sentences.en: They sponsor local Little League teaMs.
sentences.zh: 他们赞助当地的小联盟球队。

sentences.en: That's the idea that's at risk here.
sentences.zh: 这就是面临风险的理念。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, we sort of have like small, medium and large for banks.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们银行有小型、中型和大型之分。

sentences.en: Community banks, which, by the way, want to make sure everybody knows had nothing to do with this.
sentences.zh: 社区银行，顺便说一下，他们想确保每个人都知道这事与他们无关。

sentences.en: Those are the smalleSt.
sentences.zh: 那些是最小的。

sentences.en: Those are the smallest banks.
sentences.zh: 那些是规模最小的银行。

sentences.en: And then you've got your regional banks.
sentences.zh: 然后是区域性银行。

sentences.en: And they are not like the big banks in that they still have geographic knowledge and they still have the ability to develop these close personal relationships with businesses
sentences.zh: 它们与大银行不同，因为它们仍然拥有地域知识，并且仍然有能力与那些规模太小、

sentences.en: that are too small for the biggest banks to really care on the same level.
sentences.zh: 大银行根本不在乎的企业建立密切的个人关系。

sentences.en: And that's even true for Silicon Valley Bank, which banked these startups, some of which were absolutely tiny, you know,
sentences.zh: 即使对于硅谷银行来说也是如此，它为这些初创公司提供银行服务，其中一些公司绝对是非常小的，你知道的，

sentences.en: 10 people,
sentences.zh: 10个人，

sentences.en: 30 people.
sentences.zh: 30个人。

sentences.en: And that's a level of service that big banks don't provide and that made
sentences.zh: 这是大银行无法提供的服务水平，这使得

sentences.en: Silicon Valley Bank a very important institution for these very small businesses.
sentences.zh: 硅谷银行成为这些非常小的企业非常重要的机构。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And now that bank is gone.
sentences.zh: 现在那家银行倒闭了。

sentences.en: So, to summarize this, a week out, this is not feeling like a crisis that has been tied off.
sentences.zh: 所以，总结一下，一周过去了，这感觉不像是一场已经解决的危机。

sentences.en: Quite the contrary.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's still an open question.
sentences.zh: 这仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: I think everybody's still really nervous and we're not going to see things calm down until we kind of get some of the lingering problems off of our plate, whether it's
sentences.zh: 我认为每个人仍然非常紧张，在我们解决掉一些遗留问题之前，我们不会看到局势平息，无论是

sentences.en: the central banks around the world showing even more clearly than they already started to today with the ECB's interest rate hike that they're still focused on inflation
sentences.zh: 世界各地的央行——正如今天欧洲央行加息所表明的那样——比他们之前更清楚地表明他们仍然专注于通胀，

sentences.en: and they're not focused on this.
sentences.zh: 而不是专注于这件事。

sentences.en: You know, first and foremost, I think that could be a signal for everybody to kind of like move on.
sentences.zh: 你知道，首先，我认为这可能是一个信号，让大家可以继续前行。

sentences.en: But right now, we have not moved on.
sentences.zh: 但目前，我们还没有走出来。

sentences.en: To be clear, though, there isn't a reason for a regular
sentences.zh: 不过要明确一点，对于银行的普通

sentences.en: depositor of a bank to be worried about the state of their money, right?
sentences.zh: 储户来说，没有理由担心他们的钱的状态，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, maybe this is going to sound a little bit like a PSA, but if you're somebody who has money in most any bank in our country, it's generally pretty safe right now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这听起来可能有点像公益广告，但如果你在我国大多数银行存有钱，目前通常是非常安全的。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: This is not a signal to anyone to move their money.
sentences.zh: 这不是给任何人发出的转移资金的信号。

sentences.en: And if you're a business with a lick of sense, you've already taken a lesson from what we saw at the end of last week and you've called your banker and said, what are my options?
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个有头脑的企业，你已经从上周末看到的情况中吸取了教训，你已经打电话给你的银行经理说，我有什么选择？

sentences.en: What can I do to feel more secure?
sentences.zh: 我能做些什么来让自己感觉更安全？

sentences.en: And there are many options.
sentences.zh: 有很多选择。

sentences.en: There are different things you can do with your money besides leave it in enormous amounts in a bank account.
sentences.zh: 除了把巨额资金留在银行账户里，你还可以用你的钱做很多不同的事情。

sentences.en: And in addition to that,
sentences.zh: 除此之外，

sentences.en: I think regulators are also alerted to the idea that interest rate risk could be a problem for some of the other regional banks and they're going to be taking these banks aside
sentences.zh: 我认为监管机构也意识到利率风险可能对其他一些区域性银行构成问题，他们将把这些银行逐一叫到一边，

sentences.en: one by one and sitting down with them and trying to figure out how to dissipate this risk and minimize it and just make sure that the same fate that Silicon Valley
sentences.zh: 坐下来与他们沟通，试图找出如何化解和最小化这种风险，并确保硅谷银行的命运
